Outfit: 5 min; addons: several hours of hunting (or buying the items)

The rebels of {wiki:Meriana} fight against the pirates of Nargor. After gaining their trust in the {wiki:Meriana Quest}, {npc:Raymond Striker} gives you the pirate outfit. The first addon (sabre) is obtained by handing 300 pirate items to {npc:Duncan}; the second (hat) by handing {npc:Ariella} the items of the four pirate leaders.
